title: 数据质量校验器：空值率 / 唯一性 / 行数波动 / 枚举域
code:
# 数据质量校验器：空值率 / 唯一性 / 行数波动 / 枚举域
TH_NULL_RATE = 0.05      # 空值率上限 5%
TH_ROW_DRIFT = 0.30      # 行数相对基线的波动上限 30%

SCHEMA = {
    "order_id":   {"null_rate": 0.0,  "unique": True},
    "user_id":    {"null_rate": 0.02, "unique": False},
    "sku_id":     {"null_rate": 0.0,  "unique": False},
    "pay_amount": {"null_rate": 0.0,  "unique": False},
    "pay_status": {"null_rate": 0.0,  "unique": False, "domain": ["paid", "unpaid", "cancel"]},
}

# 用例 A（期望全部通过）
STAT_A = {
    "row_cnt": 1000, "baseline": 1000,
    "null_rate": {"order_id": 0.0, "user_id": 0.02, "sku_id": 0.0,
                  "pay_amount": 0.0, "pay_status": 0.0},
    "dup_keys": 0, "bad_domain": 0,
}
# 用例 B（期望有多项不通过）
STAT_B = {
    "row_cnt": 620, "baseline": 1000,
    "null_rate": {"order_id": 0.0, "user_id": 0.12, "sku_id": 0.0,
                  "pay_amount": 0.08, "pay_status": 0.0},
    "dup_keys": 3, "bad_domain": 7,
}


def check_quality(stat):
    results = []
    # ① 行数波动
    drift = abs(stat["row_cnt"] - stat["baseline"]) / stat["baseline"]
    results.append(("行数波动", round(drift, 4), drift <= TH_ROW_DRIFT))
    # ② 逐列空值率
    for col in sorted(SCHEMA):
        r = stat["null_rate"][col]
        results.append(("空值率:" + col, round(r, 4), r <= TH_NULL_RATE))
    # ③ 主键唯一性
    results.append(("主键唯一性", stat["dup_keys"], stat["dup_keys"] == 0))
    # ④ 枚举域合法性
    results.append(("枚举域合法性", stat["bad_domain"], stat["bad_domain"] == 0))
    return results


def report(tag, stat, expect_pass):
    print("== 用例 " + tag + "：" + ("质量达标批次（期望全部 PASS）" if expect_pass
                                  else "质量异常批次（期望有 FAIL）") + " ==")
    print("  行数 = " + str(stat["row_cnt"]) + "（基线 " + str(stat["baseline"]) + "）")
    res = check_quality(stat)
    for name, val, ok in res:
        print("  [" + ("PASS" if ok else "FAIL") + "] " + name + " = " + str(val))
    failed = [n for n, v, ok in res if not ok]
    all_pass = (len(failed) == 0)
    print("  未通过项 = " + str(failed))
    print("  是否符合预期 = " + str(all_pass == expect_pass))
    return failed


fa = report("A", STAT_A, True)
print("")
fb = report("B", STAT_B, False)

print("")
print("判据 1（达标批次全部通过）: " + str(len(fa) == 0))
print("判据 2（异常批次被拦下：未通过项 >= 3）: " + str(len(fb) >= 3))
print("判据 3（行数波动被检出）: " + str(any(n == "行数波动" for n in fb)))
print("判据 4（空值率超阈被检出）: " + str(any(n.startswith("空值率") for n in fb)))
print("判据 5（主键重复被检出）: " + str(any(n == "主键唯一性" for n in fb)))
